name: IPR100 radio-over-IP gateway (1 channel, desktop)
notes: Desktop gateway that links one analog two-way radio (or a 4-wire E&M line) to IP: RTP unicast/multicast and SIP, 12 VoIP channels, DTMF / CTCSS / Selcall signalling, serial data pass-through and serial channel change, web set-up, 12 V DC plug-pack. Front: status LEDs and a handset jack (Omnitronics 960 handsets). Sits on a rack shelf; superseded by the IPR110+. Check: rear connector types (radio port, serial) and the width (estimated at about 270 mm from the maker photo); the maker's manual is behind a customer login.
